description: Use when someone pastes or uploads a health insurance denial, EOB or adverse benefit determination. Pass the letter text verbatim. Returns what was denied, the reason category, the plan type (employer/ERISA, Marketplace, Medicare Advantage, Medicaid), the appeal deadline computed from the regulation, the next step and a draft appeal letter. The optional fields correct something the person stated. Deadlines are computed in code from the cited regulation. The tool does not assess medical necessity.

internal_appeal_level.description: final = this letter denies an appeal already filed

letter_date.description: Date printed on the letter, if the reader missed it

letter_text.description: The full text of the denial letter, verbatim

plan_type.description: Set only if the letter or the person says so: erisa = Employer plan (private employer, covered by ERISA); gov_employer = Government employer plan (state, county, city or school district); aca_individual = Individual or Marketplace (ACA) plan; medicare_advantage = Medicare Advantage plan; medicaid_managed = Medicaid managed care plan; medicaid_ffs = Medicaid (state agency, no managed care plan); original_medicare = Original Medicare; fehb = Federal employee plan (FEHB)

received_date.description: Day the person actually received the letter, if they say

self_funded.description: Employer plan paid by the employer itself (often 'self-funded', 'claims administrator')

stage.description: pre_service = prior authorization, post_service = a claim for care already given, concurrent = ongoing care being cut

two_level_appeals.description: Employer plan with two internal appeal levels

urgent.description: True only if the person or their doctor says waiting could seriously harm their health. Never infer it.

name: read_denial_letter
title: Read a denial letter
